name: Kor Besadii; (The Bootana Hutta region, with Kor Besadii represented by the number 3)
description: Kor Besadii was a swampy Hutt Space planet. Located in the Bootana Hutta region, it served as the throneworld of the Besadii clan of the Hutt species. The Besadii maintained vast palaces and opulent estates in the planet's swamps, and the structures were maintained by enslaved beings who frequently mounted escape attempts and even revolts.
